qa.question: What is DexerDry?

qa.question: How do I divide a deck wider than 20 feet?
alt_questions: 24 ft deck with 12 ft boards?
Can a 30 ft deck have two seams?
qa.short_answer: Treat it as smaller decks: 24 ft is two 12 ft decks, 32 ft is two 16 ft, 40 ft is two 20 ft, each split by a seam or center board with a gutter.
qa.answer: Treat it as smaller decks: 24 ft is two 12 ft decks, 32 ft is two 16 ft, 40 ft is two 20 ft, each split by a seam or center board with a gutter. Decks can be divided any way: a 30 ft deck can have two seams using 20 ft boards and 20 ft DexerDry with little or no waste (Video 05, 0:53 and 4:30 to 4:50).
